new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]):
            candidates.append((sum(v == grid[r][0] for row in grid for v in row), 'row', r))
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            candidates.append((sum(v == grid[0][c] for row in grid for v in row), 'col', c))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError('separator not found')
    _, kind, i = min(candidates)
    if kind == 'row':
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c2] != 0 else 0
             for c, c2 in zip(range(i), range(i+1, w))] for r in range(h)]
'''
